# FDG8040

> DO use the appropriate data structure name for custom data structures.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.4.1 Naming Custom Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: what the appropriate data structure name is depends on the structure. CA1710 (FDG8039) asks for the Collection suffix on some data structures; such reports are not violations of the Collection rule.

## From the book

```csharp
public class LinkedList<T> : IEnumerable<T> ,... { ... }
public class Stack<T> : ICollection<Customer> { ... }
```
